goal: Implement S1 of docs/specs/host-native-subagent-definitions.spec.md: the Claude Host Review dispatch envelope carries only the fields the Claude Agent tool accepts, and the packaged reviewer definition's native tool boundary is pinned by a test.

acceptance.assertion: Per S1 of docs/specs/host-native-subagent-definitions.spec.md (AN-2): the dispatch envelope returned by the Claude Host prepareReview has exactly the keys name and prompt; name is the packaged reviewer agent and prompt is the reservation marker line followed by the reserved prompt unchanged. It carries no max_turns and no run_in_background. ReviewRequest.maxTurns remains on the shared type and the Pi dispatch parameters are unchanged. Reservation binding, hook observation, settlement of a valid reviewer receipt, and every blocked result with its reason, release decision and recovery_action are unchanged. The generated Claude bundle matches the runtime source.

Per S1 of docs/specs/host-native-subagent-definitions.spec.md (AN-3): the packaged reviewer agent definition declares a tool allowlist that is exactly Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, so Agent, Edit, Write and NotebookEdit are natively denied; its frontmatter declares none of hooks, mcpServers or permissionMode, which the Host ignores for plugin agents; and it still states that a dispatched reviewer is never continued or re-prompted, that the reserved prompt is dispatched verbatim, and that a blocked submit_review is recovered only through its returned recovery_action. The test fails when a tool is added to or removed from the allowlist.
